patch_description:
This replaces the unstructured Gaussian sample with a deterministic, diameter-aware packing optimizer. The construction begins from several geometrically diverse seeds, including Fibonacci-sphere layouts, staggered latitude-ring layouts, and reproducible randomized spherical layouts.

The novel optimization uses a continuation objective with two coupled smooth terms: a soft minimum of squared pair distances and a soft maximum of squared pair distances. It therefore improves the actual evaluator target directly, rather than only spreading points apart as in a conventional repulsive-force method. The softening parameter is gradually sharpened, transitioning from broad global redistribution to local contact refinement. Candidate configurations are continuously centered and scale-normalized, while the best exact minimum/maximum distance ratio encountered is retained.
